name: guest-session-claim-timeout-required
hook: claimGuestConversations needs a timeout wrapper to prevent login hangs
body:
The guest session upgrade flow (claimGuestConversations) can hang if database operations stall, causing loginAction to hang indefinitely. The fix adds a withTimeout wrapper with a 5-second timeout. This is a best-effort operation (guest upgrade failure should not block login success).

Why: Without the timeout, a stalled database operation during guest claiming would cause the login button to show 'Logging in...' forever with no error or redirect.

How to apply: When adding new async operations to auth flows, consider wrapping with withTimeout if they are best-effort and should not block the overall operation.
why: The QA test revealed that if claimGuestConversations hangs, loginAction hangs. The fix demonstrates that best-effort operations should be wrapped with timeouts to prevent cascade failures.
